intro.text: With the acquisition of GetGolf, LLC in October 2025, the Company shifted its primary focus to the golf industry. GetGolf is led by industry veteran Jeff Foster. Mr. Foster’s professional background includes founding Arizona Fairways Magazine and Arizona Golf and Travel, as well as decades of experience in the golf industry, including golf course operations, golf-related media and marketing systems. As part of the acquisition of GetGolf, the Company acquired a portfolio of golf-related technology and reservation-system assets. These assets are intended to support a scalable booking and customer-engagement platform.
